report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current telemetry contradicts it: gateway metrics show error_rate 0.001 and p95 70ms, gateway logs show status 200, and order traces show OK. The only anomaly is elevated order retained heap with WARN logs, which is not established as a leak and does not explain checkout errors. Insufficient evidence for any bounded root cause; hand off.
missing_evidence: Traces showing gateway->order errors with error status and correlated order-side failure spans
Order service error-rate/latency metrics during the alert window (current metrics show error_rate 0.001, p95 70ms)
Evidence of downstream dependency timeouts or latency from order to payment/inventory/postgresql
Memory-retention time series for order to distinguish a leak from a single elevated retained-heap reading
Confirmation whether the gateway trace ERROR reflects a real checkout failure or a sampling artifact
